hero.description: Organize your game library, launch with one click, track your playtime, and manage mods — all offline. Your data belongs only to you.

features.title: Made for visual novel & indie game players
features.subtitle: From import to ending credits, tend every game in your garden with care.

items.title: Game Library
items.desc: Groups, tags, and grid / list views — gather scattered games into one garden.

items.title: Smart Import
items.desc: Archives are extracted and cataloged automatically; metadata and covers filled from Bangumi, Steam, VNDB, or IGDB in one click.

items.title: One-Click Launch
items.desc: Main executable auto-detected, with script and argument support. Press Enter and play.

items.title: Playtime Tracking
items.desc: Sessions tracked automatically in the background, revisited in a calendar view, and manually adjustable.

items.title: Mod Management
items.desc: Lossless enable / disable, loadout presets that switch whole combos at once, and scan-to-import.

items.title: Safe & Sound
items.desc: Archive passwords encrypted with AES-256-GCM in the system keychain; daily automatic database backups.

gallery.title: Screenshots
gallery.subtitle: Soft colors and a calm interface — comfortable even after hours of organizing.

download.title: Start tending your garden
download.subtitle: Free to download, open source, ready to explore and contribute.
download.zipNote: Archive import requires 7-Zip installed locally, with the 7z.exe path set in Settings.
